[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Dezon''' was a conscripted [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] serving aboard the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] [[Constrainer/Legends|''Constrainer'']]. His calculations with the [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] allowed the [[Stormhawk (Imperial I-class)|''Stormhawk'']] to capture a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
